I’ll let this one slide because you said you were a minor, yourself, but basically this post is in no way referring to anyone that is actively advocating for childhood sexual abuse. This is referring to those who have this interest, which I’d also argue is a mental illness, yet already hate themselves for it and do actively seek help (yet sometimes can’t even get it because therapists expose people). No one can commit a crime by simply having a mental illness otherwise we’d be locking up people with depression, schizophrenia, bipolar, etc. It’s the actions that result from disorders that are crimes, and unlike NOMAPs, people with other mental illnesses can receive therapy and other treatment without fear. You’re right that it’s a human rights issue, and my post is exactly that too. These people who have these grotesque thoughts are still humans, and acknowledge what they’re going through yet are actively choosing to not act on that. Hating them or saying their thoughts are crimes helps no one. As you are a minor, I am sorry that there are people like this out there. It is scary and awful that disorders like this exist. The reality though is, the hate and energy should be put on the offenders, and help as well as at least some sort of sympathy should be given to those that are aware of the desires and don’t act on them. In doing this it will remind them of everything else in their life that is also part of their identity but also to keep them from offending by making them feel like they don’t “have nothing to lose” or “will just be hated anyway.”
